name: promotion-analytics
title: Promotion analytics sinks
description: onEvent sinks for PostHog, GA4, Segment, Vercel Analytics and a GTM data layer, taking the client you already load. Flat, GA4-safe properties; one failing vendor never breaks the page or the others.
docs: <PromotionProvider onEvent={combineSinks(posthogSink(posthog), ga4Sink(gtag))}>. Pass a sink only after consent. Use { include: ['click', 'convert'] } to skip high-volume impressions.
